decisions.reason: The prescribed Board Meeting row-insertion workflow does not change the date picker method, display format, or scope.
The source replaces the Board Meeting topic-adjacent-line behavior with a row-copy workflow; it does not alter normal-Enter support or paragraph spacing in the candidate's text-entry contexts.
The fixed-margin requirement concerns the Guidance short-description section and adjacent pencil icon, not Board Meeting agenda-row insertion.
Inserting a Board Meeting row and copying its fields does not change bullet sizing, alignment, color, or visual design.
The instruction to copy fields into a newly inserted row does not change whether field placeholders clear when activated.
The Board Meeting row workflow has no effect on available theme colors or palette restrictions.
Although the workflow says to copy fields, it does not change the required help-label text, locations, hover access, or persistence.
Copying fields within a newly inserted Board Meeting row is distinct from transferring legacy-template content into new templates and does not resolve that requirement's ambiguity.
The row-copy workflow does not change the visual cue or empty-field guidance used to make editable fields discoverable.
The source describes inserting a row and copying fields, not pasting external content into tables or changing column containment and table-layout stability.
The source prescribes a task-specific Board Meeting row workflow but does not replace or modify the general text-entry field representation.
The Board Meeting row-insertion workflow does not change Tab-based list nesting, list alignment, or the unresolved list interaction.
